name: geo-spoof
summary: Answers the Geolocation API with a point you pick

shot.alt: A web page's geolocation call returning the Eiffel Tower coordinates set in Geo Spoof

hook: Chrome extension that answers the Geolocation API with a point you pick on a map.

notes: Patched calls still pass native-type checks, so pages that probe for tampering see ordinary functions.
pages.caption: bridge.js reads settings in the isolated world and hands them to inject.js, which patches the page’s own navigator.geolocation before any page script runs.

blurb: Chrome extension that overrides the Geolocation API
